content: Weight management should be a primary focus in the treatment of individuals with type 2 diabetes who are classified as overweight or obese. Clinical evidence indicates that even a modest reduction in body weight, approximately 3-7% of total body weight, can result in significant improvements in blood glucose levels. This improvement contributes to more effective management of diabetes. Furthermore, achieving moderate weight loss can decrease the reliance on glucose-lowering medications, enhance the body’s sensitivity to insulin, and, in some cases, lead to sustained remission of diabetes.
